SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

2. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

5. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

6. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
